items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Roy Palmer, I played with him too.

ctx.x: He was a good trumpet player. Yeah, I've heard about him. I played in the band with him too, drummer. I don't play in the band with Sugar Johnny. Sugar Johnny was a nice trumpet player. He played with Roy Palmer.
I knew Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer, I played with him too.

Roy Palmer. He played trumpet and tramo. He learned Kedora Ney. People will know that, but he learned Kedora Ney a whole lot. Roy Palmer. He was right down there on the Georgia Martin corner. Roy would have him tall, skinny, dark man, Roy Palmer. He died about two years ago. He used to play in the band with my daddy, Roy Palmer. Look, it's alright if you want to stop. It's alright. Do you want to go and answer the phone? Who is it, boy, though? What were you talking about? Some trumpet players. Oh, Roy Palmer.…
